title: Your devices: join the tailnet and reach the home network from outside
description:
Operator decision 2026-10-10: Tailscale should give access to the whole home network when away. ADD150 shares 192.168.1.0/24 from the Proxmox host (pve), and the route is approved — but pve is the only device in the tailnet, so nothing can use it yet. Tailscale on pve is signed in as defruscioae@gmail.com (tailnet tail3692cc.ts.net). The rest is the operator's, on their own devices: install the Tailscale app on their phone (and laptop if they want) and sign in with that same account, defruscioae@gmail.com; on the phone, turn Wi-Fi off and open http://192.168.1.25:3001/ (the control panel) to see it work from outside the house.

Done when `tailscale status` on the Proxmox host lists at least one device besides pve.
